calls.name: Nora Ellis
calls.message: Connect me to Violet Fairweather. Her library books are overdue again.

calls.name: Winston Tuttle
calls.message: Connect me to Dorothy Quinn. Just a small question about a small loan.

calls.name: Violet Fairweather
calls.message: Connect me to Winston Tuttle. I've run out of ink in the middle of a murder.

calls.name: Agatha Higgins
calls.message: Connect me to the police station. My Garfield's gone missing again!

calls.name: Clive Quinn
calls.message: Connect me to Nora Ellis. My class needs twenty copies of Hamlet.

calls.name: Dorothy Quinn
calls.message: Connect me to Dr Ravi Sharma. I sneezed twice. Is that bad?

calls.name: Dr Ravi Sharma
calls.message: Connect me to Agatha Higgins. She's late for her check-up. Again.

calls.name: Nora Ellis
calls.message: Connect me to Clive Quinn. His pupils drew moustaches in all my books.

calls.name: Agatha Higgins
calls.message: Connect me to Winston Tuttle. I need fish. Not for me. For when he comes home.

calls.name: Winston Tuttle
calls.message: Connect me to the hospital. I've dropped a crate of tins on my foot!

calls.name: Dorothy Quinn
calls.message: Connect me to Clive Quinn. My husband's forgotten his lunch again.

calls.name: Clive Quinn
calls.message: Connect me to Dorothy Quinn. Is my lunch at the bank?

calls.name: Agatha Higgins
calls.message: Connect me to PC Percy Plodwell. Any news on my handsome ginger cat?

calls.name: PC Percy Plodwell
calls.message: Connect me to Harrier Du Boid. It's Mrs Higgins' cat again.

calls.name: Harrier Du Boid
calls.message: Connect me to Winston Tuttle. Cough syrup, the strong kind. Purely professional.

calls.name: Violet Fairweather
calls.message: Connect me to Harrier Du Boid. My novel needs a real detective. Or a cheap one.

calls.name: Harrier Du Boid
calls.message: Connect me to Violet Fairweather. I have an idea for her next book.

calls.name: Winston Tuttle
calls.message: Connect me to PC Percy Plodwell. Someone keeps nicking sardines from my shop.

calls.name: Dr Ravi Sharma
calls.message: Connect me to Nora Ellis. Anything on rare diseases? Asking for a patient.

calls.name: PC Percy Plodwell
calls.message: Connect me to Dorothy Quinn. My wages are late again.

calls.name: Violet Fairweather
calls.message: Connect me to the fire station. My kitchen's on fire! I was busy writing!

calls.name: Garfield Higgins
calls.message: Connect me to Agatha Higgins. Meow.

calls.name: Mr Gnome
calls.message: Connect me to Agatha Higgins. Her cat is sleeping in my flowerbed. Again.

calls.name: Agatha Higgins
calls.message: Connect me to Garfield Higgins. I know my cat's got a phone. I pay the bill.

calls.name: Winston Tuttle
calls.message: Connect me to PC Percy Plodwell. A gnome keeps staring through my shop window.

calls.name: Harrier Du Boid
calls.message: Connect me to Dr Ravi Sharma. I need something for my head. It's a work injury.

calls.name: Violet Fairweather
calls.message: Connect me to Nora Ellis. I've finished my novel! Save me a shelf.

calls.name: Mr Gnome
calls.message: Connect me to Winston Tuttle. I need seeds. And a hat. A smaller hat.

calls.name: Clive Quinn
calls.message: Connect me to Dorothy Quinn. I've locked myself out. Again.

calls.name: Dorothy Quinn
calls.message: Connect me to Winston Tuttle. We're out of tea. This is very serious.

calls.name: Nora Ellis
calls.message: Connect me to Mr Gnome. The roses outside the library look very sad.

calls.name: Agatha Higgins
calls.message: Connect me to the fire station. Garfield's stuck up the chimney!

calls.name: Harrier Du Boid
calls.message: Connect me to the hospital. Quick! I tripped over a clue.
